capabilities: search the web for images from the command palette
insert a selected image into the current document
configure a Brave Search API key in plugin settings
extras: The manifest description says Google API, but the README instructions exclusively use the Brave Search API; the free Brave plan requires a credit card for verification, and paid tiers cost $5-$9 per 1,000 requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to find images on the web and insert them without leaving the editor.

relations.evidence: search for images via Brave Search API directly within Obsidian

requires.name: Brave Search API paid plans for higher volume

summary: Image search panel that queries the Brave Search API and inserts a chosen image into the current document.
